maui.name: Hyatt Regency Maui Resort & Spa
maui.tip: South end of Kāʻanapali Beach. Sprawling pool complex with a waterslide and lagoon, nightly luau, family-friendly. [verify rating] (Yelp listing tracks reviews under SpaWell/Hyatt; ~1,300+ Yelp reviews, ~4.5 on Hyatt.com) [verify].

maui.name: Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa
maui.tip: Sits on Black Rock (Puʻu Kekaʻa) at the north end of Kāʻanapali — best snorkeling on the beach, nightly cliff-diving ceremony. 2605 Kaanapali Pkwy. [verify rating] (984 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: The Westin Kāʻanapali Ocean Resort Villas
maui.tip: Villa-style units with kitchens north of Kāʻanapali proper — good for families needing space. Multiple pools. 6 Kai Ala Dr, Lahaina. [verify rating] (902 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: OUTRIGGER Honua Kai Resort & Spa
maui.tip: Condo-resort on Kāʻanapali North Beach with full kitchens and a five-pool aquatic playground — a family favorite. 130 Kai Malina Pkwy, Lahaina. [verify rating] (685 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort
maui.tip: Fronts Wailea Beach across 40 acres — nine-pool canyon with water elephant slide and a lazy river, plus adults-only pool and Kilolani Spa. 3850 Wailea Alanui Dr. [verify rating] (1,638 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort
maui.tip: Design-forward Hyatt resort on Mokapu Beach at the north end of Wailea — tiered infinity pools stepping down to the sand. 3550 Wailea Alanui Dr. [verify rating] (~753 Yelp reviews; ~4.5 on Hyatt.com) [verify].

maui.name: Fairmont Kea Lani
maui.tip: All-suite-and-villa resort overlooking Polo Beach — quieter south end of Wailea, family-friendly and roomy. 4100 Wailea Alanui Dr. [verify rating] (703 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: Wailea Beach Resort - Marriott, Maui
maui.tip: 22 oceanfront acres between Wailea and Ulua beaches — home to Hawaii's longest resort waterslide; 15 min from Kahului airport. 3700 Wailea Alanui Dr. [verify rating] (945 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: Maui Coast Hotel
maui.tip: Mid-budget Kīhei pick a block off Kamaʻole beaches; new Kai Tower (opened 2024), free shuttle, pool. 2259 S Kihei Rd. 4.5 stars, 431 Yelp reviews.

maui.name: Paia Inn
maui.tip: Boutique inn in the heart of Paʻia town on the North Shore — Southeast-Asian styling, private beach access path, walkable to surf shops and cafes. 93 Hana Hwy, Paʻia. [verify rating] (120 Yelp reviews) [verify].

maui.name: Hana-Maui Resort, a Destination by Hyatt
maui.tip: The only full resort in remote Hāna at the end of the Road to Hāna — low-key cottages, sea-ranch setting, near Hāmoa Beach. 5031 Hana Hwy, Hāna. NOTE: only 63 Yelp reviews (below the 100 threshold); ~8.9/10 on U.S. News [verify]. [verify rating].

hawaii.name: Mauna Kea Beach Hotel, Autograph Collection
hawaii.tip: Iconic Kaunaʻoa Bay crescent — one of the best swimming/snorkel beaches on the island. Marriott Autograph property, classic mid-century resort feel.

hawaii.name: Fairmont Orchid, Hawaiʻi
hawaii.tip: Protected sheltered cove (Pauoa Bay) is calm and great for families and snorkeling. Sprawling oceanfront grounds on the Kohala Coast.

hawaii.name: The Westin Hapuna Beach Resort
hawaii.tip: Sits above Hapuna Beach State Park, repeatedly ranked among the best beaches in the U.S. Wide white-sand bay, strong shorebreak on big-surf days.

hawaii.name: Mauna Lani, Auberge Resorts Collection
hawaii.tip: Recently renovated luxury resort with calm swimming beach, ancient fishponds, and easy access to Makaiwa Bay. Adults and families both well served.

hawaii.name: Four Seasons Resort Hualālai
hawaii.tip: Top-tier luxury on the Kona-Kohala line at Kaʻūpūlehu. Seven pools including a saltwater snorkel lagoon stocked with reef fish — excellent for kids.

hawaii.name: OUTRIGGER Kona Resort & Spa
hawaii.tip: Oceanfront in Keauhou (formerly Sheraton Kona). Manta rays gather off the point at night — viewing area on property. Tide-pool shoreline, no sandy beach.

hawaii.name: Royal Kona Resort
hawaii.tip: Walkable to historic Kailua-Kona town (Aliʻi Drive). Private saltwater lagoon for swimming since there's no sandy beach at the property itself.

hawaii.name: Kona Coast Resort
hawaii.tip: Condo-style villas in Keauhou with kitchens and multiple pools — good value for families. Drive to nearby beaches; no beach on site.
hawaii.note: [verify rating] — review count not confirmed. Coordinates [verify].

hawaii.name: Grand Naniloa Hotel Hilo, a DoubleTree by Hilton
hawaii.tip: On Hilo Bay with a 9-hole golf course and easy access to Liliʻuokalani Gardens and Coconut Island. Hilo-side bay water is calm but not a swim beach.
hawaii.note: [verify rating] — Yelp rating/review count not confirmed. Coordinates [verify].

hawaii.name: Hilo Hawaiian Hotel, Trademark Collection by Wyndham
hawaii.tip: Classic Hilo Bay hotel with the best Mauna Kea / Coconut Island views in town. Short drive to Richardson Ocean Park black-sand snorkel beach.
hawaii.note: [verify rating] — Yelp rating/review count not confirmed. Coordinates [verify].

hawaii.name: Volcano Village Lodge
hawaii.tip: Adults-only rainforest cottages minutes from Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park. Base camp for the Kaʻū/Volcano side — not a beach stay.

hawaii.name: Volcano House
hawaii.tip: The only hotel inside Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park, perched on the rim of Kīlauea caldera. Crater views from the lobby; closest lodging to active volcano viewing.
